## Projects

- [Golden Poppy School](https://goldenpoppyschool.com/): Golden Poppy is a preschool and daycare in Corte Madera, California. Work: keyword research for program and Corte Madera location searches, optimised meta titles, descriptions and headings on the program pages, technical audits in Screaming Frog and Search Console to fix crawl and indexing issues, internal linking between program pages and the book a tour page, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [Leaps and Bounds](https://leapsandboundsschool.com/): Leaps and Bounds runs daycare and preschool centres in La Puente, Escondido and Fontana, California. Work: keyword research for daycare and preschool searches in each branch area, on-page work on titles, meta descriptions, headings and URLs for program and location pages, technical audits to find and fix crawl and indexing issues, internal linking so each branch connects to its programs and enquiry page, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [GoodEarth Montessori School](https://goodearthmontessorischool.com/): GoodEarth is a Montessori school in Chino Hills, California. Work: keyword research around Montessori, preschool and Chino Hills searches, optimised titles, meta descriptions and headings on the school and program pages, fixed technical issues found in Search Console and Screaming Frog audits, structured page content and internal links towards enrollment, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [All Seasons Children Learning Center](https://www.allseasonsclc.com/): All Seasons CLC is a preschool and daycare centre in Arcadia, California. Work: keyword research for preschool, nursery and daycare searches in Arcadia, on-page optimisation of titles, meta descriptions and headings, content structuring for the homepage and the FAQ section, technical audits to keep pages crawlable and indexed, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [Mission Bay Montessori Academy](https://www.mbmacademy.com/): Mission Bay Montessori Academy is a Montessori school in San Diego. Work: keyword research for preschool and Montessori daycare searches in San Diego, optimised meta titles, descriptions, headings and URLs on program pages, technical checks in Search Console for indexing issues, internal linking between programs, admissions and schedule a tour pages, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [JJ HealthCare Products](https://jjhealthcareproducts.com/): JJ HealthCare Products is a Canadian supplier of mobility and medical equipment based in Etobicoke, serving Toronto and the GTA. Work: keyword research for product categories and Toronto area searches, optimised product and category pages: titles, meta descriptions, headings and image alt text, technical audits to fix crawl and indexing issues across the catalogue, internal linking between categories, products and funding pages, both Google Business Profiles optimised.
- [ECTN Africa](https://ectn-africa.com/): ECTN Africa is run by Seanautic Marine in Canada, which issues ECTN and cargo tracking certificates (CTN, BSC, BESC and BIETC) for shipments going to African countries. Work: keyword research around ECTN, CTN and BSC certificate searches, on-page optimisation of service and country requirement pages, technical audits in Screaming Frog and Search Console, internal linking from information pages to the quote request form, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [Assurance and Audit](https://assuranceandaudit.com.au/): Assurance and Audit is an audit firm in South East Queensland, Australia. Work: keyword research and competitor analysis for audit and assurance services, optimised titles, meta descriptions and headings on each service page, technical SEO setup and audits for a new website, internal linking between blog posts and service pages, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [Gotham Electrical](https://gothamelectrical.au/): Gotham Electrical is an electrical company in Western Sydney serving Penrith and the Blue Mountains. Work: keyword research for electrician and service searches in Western Sydney, on-page optimisation of service and package pages, internal linking between service pages and the contact page, technical audits to fix crawl and indexing issues.
- [Electa](https://electa-ksv.com/): Electa, based in Croatia, makes natural wellness products such as colloidal silver water, zeolite and kombucha, plus skin care for the whole family. Work: keyword research for the main product types, optimised product and category pages: titles, meta descriptions and alt text, technical audits to fix crawl and indexing issues, internal linking between blog posts and products.
- [Brompton Carpets](https://bromptoncarpets.co.uk/): Brompton Carpets is a carpet shop in Chelsea, London. Work: keyword research for carpet shop and carpet type searches in London, on-page optimisation of category and supplier pages, technical audits to fix crawl and indexing issues, internal linking between carpet types, suppliers and the contact page, Google Business Profile optimisation.
- [Rania Zara Studio](https://www.raniazara.co.uk/): Rania Zara Studio is a UK store for Pakistani luxury designer wear. Work: website changes, fixes and day to day Shopify store updates, product uploads with optimised titles, descriptions and image alt text, on-page work on collection and designer pages, regular SEO reports from GA4 and Search Console.
- [Jewellery By Mash](https://jewellerybymash.com/): Jewellery By Mash is a UK based store for Pakistani and Indian jewellery. Work: website changes, fixes and Shopify store updates, product uploads with optimised titles, descriptions and image alt text, on-page work on collection pages and meta tags, regular SEO reports from GA4 and Search Console.
- [Voyager Allied Health](https://voyageralliedhealth.com.au/): Voyager Allied Health provides mobile allied health support for NDIS participants in Australia. Work: keyword research for NDIS therapy services in each city, optimised titles, meta descriptions and headings on service and location pages, technical SEO setup and audits for a new website, internal linking between services, locations and the referral page.
- [Sapphire Catering](https://www.sapphirecatering.com/): Sapphire Catering is a catering company in Orange County, California. Work: created new service pages for its catering services, keyword research for catering searches across Orange County cities, optimised titles, meta descriptions and headings on service and location pages, internal linking between services, locations and the contact page.
- [Fortune Cove Lodge](https://fortunecovelodge.co.nz/): Fortune Cove Lodge is a private luxury lodge above Lake Wakatipu in Queenstown, New Zealand. Work: keyword research for Queenstown luxury accommodation searches, optimised titles, meta descriptions and headings across the site, content structuring for the homepage and FAQ section, technical audits to keep pages crawlable and indexed, Google Business Profile optimisation.
